panels.description: Minimum exporter readiness across the selected job and instances. This is local readiness; with account polling enabled it requires the first accepted account snapshot.
panels.title: Exporter readiness

panels.description: Age of each endpoint's latest successful exporter snapshot. With the default 10-second poll interval, green is fresh, yellow is delayed, and red is operationally stale.
panels.title: Endpoint data age

panels.description: Logical Braiins API poll rate by endpoint and bounded result category. Counters are shown as rates using Grafana's rate interval; missing data means that endpoint has not emitted request counters for the selected targets.
panels.title: API poll result rate

panels.description: Current Braiins rewards balance in BTC from the profile current_balance field, summed across selected exporter instances. This is not the Funds-page available balance. Omitted by the exporter when the profile field is absent; no account identifier is exported.
panels.title: Rewards balance

panels.description: Account-level worker counts by normalized Braiins state. These are aggregate counts from the profile endpoint and do not reveal worker names.
panels.title: Account workers by state

panels.description: Number of selected exporter scrape targets exposing the always-present readiness metric. No data usually means Prometheus is not scraping the exporter or the selected variables match no series.
panels.title: Selected instances

panels.description: Age of the last accepted pool-stats snapshot inside this exporter. Green is 0-30s, yellow 30-60s, and red above 60s for the default 10-second poll interval.
panels.title: Pool stats freshness

panels.description: Braiins pool-wide hashrate converted in the dashboard from the exported Gh/s metric to EH/s. Exporter metric names and units remain unchanged.
panels.title: Pool hashrate (EH/s)

panels.description: Pool-wide active worker count from the authenticated Braiins Pool stats endpoint. Active users are intentionally absent because the documented API does not expose that field.
panels.title: Pool active workers

panels.description: Worker hashrate converted in the dashboard from the exported Gh/s metric to TH/s. Values around 30000 Gh/s display as about 30 TH/s.
panels.title: Worker hashrate (TH/s)

panels.description: Source update timestamp reported by Braiins for the pool stats payload. The exported value is Unix seconds and is multiplied by 1000 here so Grafana renders a real date/time instead of a 1970-era millisecond interpretation.
panels.title: Pool source update time

panels.description: Account hashrate converted in the dashboard from the exported Gh/s metric to TH/s. Exporter metric names and units remain unchanged.
panels.title: Account hashrate (TH/s)

panels.description: Number of selected workers currently in each one-hot state. Colors are fixed per state rather than threshold-driven.
panels.title: Worker states

panels.description: Bounded-window payout fees in satoshis by normalized rail and status. Missing data can mean payouts are disabled, no first success has occurred, or the selected targets do not expose payout metrics.
panels.title: Payout fees

panels.description: Current worker status joined from instant Prometheus queries. Worker names come from runtime labels; the dashboard does not store operator worker names. Last-share timestamps are Unix seconds converted to milliseconds for Grafana display.
panels.title: Worker status table

panels.description: Rolling-window shares reported by the workers endpoint. Shares are gauges, not counters, so they are not wrapped in rate(). Worker labels may be private.
panels.title: Worker shares by window

panels.description: Age since each worker's last accepted share. Green is recent, yellow is delayed, and red indicates a stale last-share signal.
panels.title: Worker last-share age

panels.description: Today's reward totals by component. Zero-valued components are kept visible so missing optional reward components are explicit.
panels.title: Rewards by component

panels.description: Recent payout amount totals by bounded rail/status labels. Zero-valued combinations are preserved so rail/status coverage remains visible.
panels.title: Payout amounts by rail/status

panels.description: Exporter poll success timestamp by endpoint. The exported value is Unix seconds and is multiplied by 1000 here so Grafana renders the metric value as date/time.
panels.title: Last successful poll

panels.description: Ratio of failed API polls by endpoint. Healthy endpoints fall back to 0% when request telemetry exists but no failure series is present.

targets.expr: (sum by (endpoint) (rate(braiins_pool_api_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result!="success"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (endpoint) (rate(braiins_pool_api_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-12)) or (0 * sum by (endpoint) (rate(braiins_pool_api_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: API failed poll ratio

list.description: Optional runtime worker filter. Worker labels may reveal operator naming conventions; no worker name is stored in this dashboard JSON.
list.label: Worker
list.name: worker
